homeHero.title: Style is the outward expression of inner confidence.
homeHero.subtitle: The first Uzbek premium barbershop in South Korea. Every visit is not just a haircut — it's a transformation.

servicesSection.title: Precision in every detail.
servicesSection.description: Choose your service. Precision, cleanliness, and flawless results — guaranteed with every visit.

classicCut.name: The Classic
classicCut.description: Scissor and clipper work refined over thousands of cuts. Clean lines, natural movement, and a finish that looks as good on day five as day one.

beardStyling.name: Beard Sculpt
beardStyling.description: We read the angles of your face and carve a beard that belongs there. Sharp edges, soft blends, zero guesswork.

skinFade.name: Skin Fade
skinFade.description: From zero to hero. A seamless gradient from skin to length that demands a double-take in the mirror.

fatherSon.name: Father & Son
fatherSon.description: Two chairs, one shared experience. Bring your boy in and both walk out looking sharp. A memory and a fresh cut, all in one visit.

deluxePackage.name: The Full Experience
deluxePackage.description: Haircut. Beard detail. Hot towel. Wash. This is not just grooming, it is a reset. Walk out feeling brand new.

hairColor.name: Color Refresh
hairColor.description: Subtle tone work that blends greys naturally and brings warmth back. Nobody will know, but everybody will notice.

extras.processTwo: Your barber works with steady hands and fresh blades
extras.processThree: Final details, lineup, and a mirror check you will love
extras.popularText: Skin Fade paired with a Beard Sculpt is the combination our clients keep coming back for. Clean, modern, undeniable.
extras.processOne: A quick conversation about what you want and what will work
extras.memberText: Lock in a monthly membership for priority booking, better rates, and the kind of consistency your look deserves.

aboutSection.title: Traditional craft. Modern standard.
aboutSection.description: Our barbershop has been serving clients since 2019 and is recognized as the first Uzbek barbershop in South Korea.
aboutSection.storyText: It began in 2019 with one chair and a bold vision. We made history as the first Uzbek barbershop in South Korea. What started small became the place our community trusts for a fresh cut, honest conversation, and a moment to breathe.

precision.title: Obsessive Detail
precision.text: Every fade, every line, every edge is finished like our reputation depends on it. Because it does.

hospitality.title: Warmth You Can Feel
hospitality.text: You are not a ticket number here. You are a guest. Expect tea, conversation, and a chair that feels like it was waiting for you.

hygiene.title: Clean Without Compromise
hygiene.text: Fresh blades, sanitized tools, spotless stations. Every time, no exceptions, no shortcuts.

craft.title: Never Finished Learning
craft.text: Our barbers train constantly, study new techniques, and push each other to be better than yesterday.

jamshid.name: Jamshid
jamshid.bio: Twelve years of fades, lineups, and beard work that speaks for itself. Jamshid is the steady hand clients trust with their look.

sardor.name: Sardor
sardor.bio: Sardor sees texture and shape where others see hair. His finishing work turns a good cut into something you cannot stop touching.

aziz.name: Aziz
aziz.bio: From hot towels to beard oils, Aziz turns a haircut into an experience. The kind of visit where you forget to check your phone.

aboutSection.ctaDescription: Sit in our chair once and you will understand why our clients keep coming back. Book a time that works for you.

extras.timelineOne: One chair, one barber, one neighborhood that believed in us from day one.
extras.timelineTwo: A full team, expanded services, and a reputation built entirely by word of mouth.
extras.timelineThree: Thousands of regulars, a loyal community, and a craft we sharpen every single day.

jamshid.bio: Eight years of reading faces and knowing exactly what cut will make you look twice in the mirror. Fades and beard work are his language.

sardor.name: Sardor
sardor.bio: Sardor turns a trim into a statement. His beard shaping is surgical, and his eye for modern detail keeps clients coming back week after week.

aziz.name: Aziz
aziz.bio: If you want something bold, Aziz is your guy. Color work, sharp designs, and grooming that feels like a ritual, not a routine.

doston.name: Doston
doston.bio: Doston believes the classics never go out of style. His scissor work is clean, his tapers are tight, and his finishes are always sharp.

islom.name: Islom
islom.bio: Young, hungry, and surprisingly precise. Islom brings fresh energy to every chair and a level of care that clients notice immediately.
